name: Table of Contents
description: Adds an automatic table of contents to long posts and pages: collects the h2–h4 headings, gives them stable anchor ids and inserts a nested list after the first paragraph or at a [toc] marker.
author: sap13ns

settings.label: Minimum headings
settings.help: The table only appears when a post has at least this many headings.

settings.label: Deepest heading level
settings.help: h2 lists only the main sections; h4 also lists sub-subsections.

settings.label: Title
settings.help: Empty uses "Contents", or "Índice" for Spanish posts.

settings.label: Show on
settings.help: Which content types get a table of contents.
